## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines (ruff lint passes)
- [ ] Type annotations are complete (mypy strict passes)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for new functionality
- [ ] Test coverage meets threshold (core ≥90%, tools ≥80%)
- [ ] No sensitive information exposed in code or logs
- [ ] Commit message follows convention: `type(scope): description`

## Description

Brief description of changes...

## Related Issues

Closes #

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: New feature
- [ ] fix: Bug fix
- [ ] refactor: Code refactoring
- [ ] perf: Performance improvement
- [ ] docs: Documentation update
- [ ] test: Test addition/update
- [ ] chore: Build/CI changes

## Testing

Describe how you tested this change...
